title: How a construction-site photo gets its label
desc: The client uploads a construction-site photo to an API with key authentication and usage-based pricing. Qwen3.5-9B on AWS SageMaker, prompted with the construction taxonomy, labels the photo by trade and phase, such as structural, MEP, finishing or sitework.
caption: Manifold's classification API, from upload to label.
